burst: Deals 35.16% of final ATK as sustained damage every 1 sec, stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 10 sec. — the 10-stack CAP is not modeled; the engine appends one independent DoT instance per burst cast and never dedups, so concurrent instances approximate stacking without enforcing the ceiling.

⛑ Sakura Petals DoT re-application: at interval 15s vs durationSec 15s the instances abut rather than overlap. If the real CD is shorter than 15s, the append-not-refresh engine would MULTIPLY the DoT. Verify cadence before trusting burst-adjacent totals.
⛑ Burst 10-hit split: modeled as 10 discrete 457.14% hits (text says 'Attacks sequentially 10 times'). If popups show one merged number, damage is identical but crit variance is not.
⛑ Burst DoT stack cap of 10 unenforced (see unmodeled).

override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⛑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read from kit prose only. Full-kit audit: 8 kit lines total. Implemented 4 (skill2 Dancing Flower Attack Damage buff, skill2 Sakura Petals sustained DoT, burst 10x sequential hit, burst stacking sustained DoT). Skipped 4, all in skill1: the start-of-battle force-cast (folded into skill2's first-fire phase) and three part-destruction riders (the scope-lock boss is partless and TriggerDef has no partDestroyed kind, so all three are permanently inert). Load-bearing uncertainty is skill2's kit-silent cooldown, which drives BOTH the Attack Damage uptime and the 256%/s DoT's re-application rate — the single largest damage lever in this kit.

flags.reasoning: The kit states NO cooldown for Skill 2. Both skill2 lines carry a 15s duration, and the skill1 force-cast implies skill2 is meant to be up from t=0. Setting the interval equal to the duration yields seamless-but-non-overlapping uptime, the least-assuming choice. The datamined skillCooldownsSec field is not in this packet.
flags.recipe: Read skillCooldownsSec for slot 2 from the datamine; cross-check against footage by counting Sakura Petals DoT tick popups — gaps between tick trains give the real CD directly. If CD < 15s the append-not-refresh engine will stack DoT instances and inflate damage superlinearly.
